title: keywords/headers/body_values skip_serializing_if=is_empty violates RFC 8621 default-field contract
description: RFC 8621 §4.1.1 defines keywords with default:{} and RFC 8620 §5.1 says a server MUST include default-value properties. With skip_serializing_if="HashMap::is_empty", a server using this type serializes an Email with zero keywords as {"id":"...", ...} omitting "keywords" entirely. Same issue for body_values, text_body, html_body, attachments, headers (skip on empty). A server would need to patch the output or avoid using these types for final serialization. This is a silent footgun for jmap-mail-server. Fix: document that these types are not safe for server serialization of full-property responses, or restructure to avoid skip_serializing_if on default-value fields.
